findings.statement: Declared offsets do not delimit the declared quote: the locator claims [0,43) but the quote is 9 characters and searches back at [0,9). The byte-exactness contract (G2 E4: text[start:end] == quote) is therefore violated by the only whole-document asset locator.

evidence.window_at_declared_offsets:
## ① 案例介绍

**节点**：IN15-O1「自回归O1·饱和脉搏度量管线成熟化

findings.why_it_matters: Asset registration is the hash/offset anchor the rest of the line builds on. An unverified offset is either sloppiness that the gate cannot catch or a hand-written number presented as computed — 01's own report says all quotes come from the source verbatim, which is what E4 is there to prove.
findings.gate_visibility: G2 reads `start_offset`/`end_offset`; this locator uses `char_start`/`char_end` (gate keys present=False). E3/E4 therefore fall through to verbatim search and PASS, so the wrong offsets are invisible to the programmatic gate.
findings.remediation: Either drop the offsets for ast-5611-01 (verbatim-quote search already resolves, content_ref.sha256 pins the document) or emit the real span [0,9) under the gate's key names `start_offset`/`end_offset` and re-verify with ke/wp_gate.locator_matches().

findings.statement: The report names `tools/pulse/gen_pulse_figures.py` among the implementation artifacts, but no asset in the manifest covers it. The markdown yields 14 distinct artifact paths; 13 of them are covered by the manifest's entries (ast-5611-02 is record metadata with no path), and the remaining one is this module. 01's stated purpose is a complete inventory, so a silent omission is a completeness defect even though every registered entry is faithful.
findings.why_it_matters: A dropped artifact is invisible downstream: 02/03 and any asset-completeness audit read the manifest, not the prose. Silent omission is exactly the failure mode 01 exists to prevent (G1 'xref closure' has no analogue for prose mentions).
findings.gate_visibility: No programmatic gate compares manifest coverage against the prose of the source document — recall is only visible to an independent reviewer.
findings.reproduction:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
md=pathlib.Path('work/kf-wp-5611/source_5611.md').read_text()

d=json.load(open('docs/kf/wp-5611-01/kf_result.json'))
names=[a['name'] for a in d['outputs']['asset_manifest.json']['assets'] if a['kind']=='code_reference']
print('tools/pulse/gen_pulse_figures.py' in names, names)
PY
findings.remediation: Register `tools/pulse/gen_pulse_figures.py` as a code_reference with the same verbatim-quote locator convention as ast-5611-06 (resolvable=false / referenced_in_markdown_not_fetched), which also brings the code-reference count in the package report from 5 to 6.

findings.statement: Figure assets are name/caption-addressed only: the report record exposes `name`+`caption` and no bytes, so no content hash can be pinned. Not a producer defect (the source has no payload) but it means figure identity downstream rests on filenames, unlike ast-5611-01 which is hash-pinned.
findings.why_it_matters: Dedup/drift detection on figures is name-based; a renamed figure silently becomes a new asset.
findings.gate_visibility: none — G2 cannot hash what the source does not expose.
findings.remediation: When the platform starts storing figure bytes, add content_ref.sha256 per figure; until then keep the limitation recorded.

findings.statement: The whole-document asset's quote is 9 characters, below the gate's E6 floor of 12 for a *trivial* quote. Acceptable here only because content_ref.sha256 pins the entire document; if the pattern were copied to a per-claim locator it would be refused by E6.
findings.why_it_matters: Template risk: the 01 locator convention is what 03 will copy.
findings.gate_visibility: E6 would flag it for evidence locators (min-quote-chars=12).
findings.remediation: Quote a longer verbatim span for the document anchor.

findings.statement: Existence and content of the 9 referenced code/evidence paths could not be independently verified: no TensorPlatform checkout exposing tools/pulse/ exists on this host, and 01 deliberately did not fetch them. Their `resolvable:false` / `referenced_in_markdown_not_fetched` labels are therefore neither confirmed nor refuted here — marked not_run, not passed.
findings.why_it_matters: A manifest that lists paths the file system does not have would still pass every structural check.
findings.gate_visibility: none — G2 resolves locators in the markdown, never on disk.
findings.remediation: When the platform exposes artifact storage, add an existence probe to the 01 pipeline and record it per asset.

Two major, non-corrupting defects: a mis-declared locator offset that the programmatic gate cannot see (F-01) and one report-named implementation module missing from the inventory (F-02). Both are cheap to fix inside 01, so the package is returned for changes rather than rejected.
